plugin.name: SquareSoft_UI_Installer
plugin.author: OpenAI
plugin.purpose: Installs/updates the SquareSoft UI suite and applies the bundled saved window layout.
plugin.description:
SQUARESOFT UI INSTALLER v2.21
Put this installer and all suite XML files in the same folder.
All static theme gutter graphics plus warning/critical-alert gutter graphics are bundled in this folder.
Production build: Autobuff Tracker and Chakra Cooldown are installed with the suite but disabled by default. Enable either from MUSHclient's Plugins dialog if desired.
A preconfigured SquareSoft_UI_Layout.txt is bundled and will be loaded after all suite plugins have been installed. The Plugin Controller compares the saved 1899x968 reference canvas from its 1920x1080 source monitor with the recipient's PRIMARY MONITOR resolution. It scales window geometry and gutters from monitor size, preserves edge anchoring (including ultrawide layouts), and gently scales common UI fonts. The current MUSHclient window size is not used to choose the first-install scale.
The MUSHclient WORLD OUTPUT font is standardized to Consolas 11 point before layout/gutter restoration, so the text-area geometry is measured against the portable suite font rather than an arbitrary local world font. The installer synchronizes both the live font and MUSHclient's serialized output_font_* world options. After the final layout/gutter restore it saves the WORLD file itself, and also reasserts the font once after startup to avoid load-order overrides.
The bundled canonical layout is the author-supplied 1920x1080 profile dated 2026-09-14 02:55:56. World Map placement is preserved through its hidden placeholder phase so its first visible render cannot snap back to 0,0.
Commands: suite install - reinstall/update plugins, then apply saved layout suite install bare - reinstall/update plugins WITHOUT applying layout suite layout - apply SquareSoft_UI_Layout.txt now suite status - show bundled plugin status suite portable on - enable the portable world-trigger replacements suite portable off - disable those portable trigger groups suite portable status - show their state suite path - show the suite folder
IMPORTANT: The initial suite install is deliberately DEFERRED until after this installer's own OnPluginInstall callback has returned. This avoids nested/re-entrant plugin installation while MUSHclient is still installing the bootstrap plugin.
The installer includes the real Generic_Chat_Miniwindow-based COMMUNICATION panel supplied by the suite author plus SquareSoft_Chat_Router.xml, which owns its SquareSoft channel/tell capture rules and forwards original MUD style runs. Router-caught chat is miniwindow-only: the raw server line is omitted and routed through a dedicated no-echo API, so it cannot be duplicated in the main output. SquareSoft_Core_Triggers.xml owns the portable status-colour and cooldown-notice triggers that previously belonged in the world file.

muclient.script:
SELF_ID = GetPluginID() PLUGIN_CONTROLLER_ID = "5f2a91c7d3e84b60a1c9e742" CORE_TRIGGERS_ID = "f3a9c2e71b4d4068a5c912ef" CHAT_ROUTER_ID = "e4b8d2a16c3f4079b5a821dc" LAYOUT_FILENAME = "SquareSoft_UI_Layout.txt" INSTALLER_VERSION = "2.21" WORLD_OUTPUT_FONT_NAME = "Consolas" WORLD_OUTPUT_FONT_POINTS = 11
-- Load order matters: -- 1) shared theme semantics -- 2) gutter/text-area layout -- 3) ordinary windows -- 4) world-map before automapper -- 5) Plugin Controller last, after all windows exist SUITE = { { id="43c8d047be7a418ba5e86916", file="UI_Theme_Controller.xml", name="Theme Controller" }, { id="7b4e91c2a6d34f0ca8e12573", file="UI_Layout_Controller.xml", name="Layout Controller (gutters)" },
{ id="f3a9c2e71b4d4068a5c912ef", file="SquareSoft_Core_Triggers.xml", name="Core Triggers" },
{ id="e6b4af7c21934f40891cba37", file="Autobuff_Tracker.xml", name="Autobuff Tracker", default_enabled=false }, { id="b27a41c9f0e34d8ab6023117", file="Chakra_Cooldown.xml", name="Chakra Cooldown", default_enabled=false },
{ id="d47f6a92e1b83c5f0a9e2716", file="HP_MP_Gauges.xml", name="HP / MP Gauges" }, { id="91c7e4a23bf84d1aa0e9c562", file="Status_Effect_Tracker.xml", name="Status Effect Tracker" }, { id="a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c", file="ExitWindow.xml", name="Exit Compass" }, { id="6a941f23b8ce4a2d9e7051bc", file="Travel_Alias_Window.xml", name="Travel Shortcuts" }, { id="a1e4bf29c1a8477fa19b2201", file="XP_Rate_Tracker.xml", name="XP / AP / Gold Rates" }, { id="c39d5271e8a04f6b9c418823", file="Enemy_Bestiary_Tracker.xml", name="Enemy Bestiary Tracker" }, { id="7f3e21b0a94d4d73b87c34e2", file="World_Map_Window.xml", name="World Map Window" }, { id="a7c3e91b4d6f2085c1e73a9d", file="SquareSoft_Automapper.xml", name="SquareSoft Automapper" },
{ id="10778718503f0c91106745f5", file="Generic_Chat_Miniwindow.xml", name="Communication / Generic Chat" }, { id="e4b8d2a16c3f4079b5a821dc", file="SquareSoft_Chat_Router.xml", name="SquareSoft Chat Router" },
{ id=PLUGIN_CONTROLLER_ID, file="SquareSoft_Plugin_Controller.xml", name="Plugin Controller" } }
function InstallerNote(colour, message) ColourNote( colour or "lime", "", "[SquareSoft Installer] " .. tostring(message or "") ) end
function SuiteDirectory() local dir = tostring(GetPluginInfo(SELF_ID, 20) or "") if dir == "" then return "" end
local last = dir:sub(-1) if last ~= "\\" and last ~= "/" then dir = dir .. "\\" end
return dir end
function JoinSuitePath(filename) return SuiteDirectory() .. tostring(filename or "") end
function FileExists(path) local f = io.open(path, "rb") if not f then return false end f:close() return true end
-- World-output typography is a suite-level presentation setting, not a -- miniwindow-layout concern. Apply it before gutter/layout work because the -- layout controller measures the output font when reserving usable text width. function ApplyWorldOutputFont(announce) -- SetOutputFont changes the live display, but the world serializer writes -- output_font_name/output_font_height/output_font_weight. Keep both the -- live font and the serialized world options synchronized. local ok, err = pcall( SetOutputFont, WORLD_OUTPUT_FONT_NAME, WORLD_OUTPUT_FONT_POINTS )
if not ok then if announce ~= false then InstallerNote( "red", "Could not set output font to " .. WORLD_OUTPUT_FONT_NAME .. " " .. tostring(WORLD_OUTPUT_FONT_POINTS) .. " pt: " .. tostring(err) ) end return false end
-- IMPORTANT: despite the public option table describing output_font_height -- as pixels, MUSHclient's ChangeFont implementation treats the stored value -- as a POINT SIZE and converts it to pixels internally with MulDiv(..., DPI, 72). -- Therefore persist 11 here. Do NOT persist GetInfo(212), which is the -- rendered pixel height and would reopen as an ~18-point font on common DPI. local rcName = SetAlphaOption("output_font_name", WORLD_OUTPUT_FONT_NAME) local rcHeight = SetOption("output_font_height", WORLD_OUTPUT_FONT_POINTS) local rcWeight = SetOption("output_font_weight", 400)
local optionsOK = rcName == error_code.eOK and rcHeight == error_code.eOK and rcWeight == error_code.eOK
if announce ~= false then if optionsOK then InstallerNote( "gray", "World output font: " .. WORLD_OUTPUT_FONT_NAME .. " " .. tostring(WORLD_OUTPUT_FONT_POINTS) .. " pt (saved size " .. tostring(WORLD_OUTPUT_FONT_POINTS) .. ")." ) else InstallerNote( "yellow", "Consolas 11 is active, but one or more persistent world-font " .. "options could not be changed (name=" .. tostring(rcName) .. ", height=" .. tostring(rcHeight) .. ", weight=" .. tostring(rcWeight) .. ")." ) end end
return optionsOK end
function ScheduleWorldOutputFontReassert() -- Some MUSHclient builds finish applying world display options after plugins -- begin loading. Reassert once after startup so load order cannot undo the -- suite font in the live session. DoAfterSpecial( 0.75, "ApplyWorldOutputFont(false)", sendto.script ) end
-- SetOutputFont changes the live world, but MUSHclient only makes that change -- permanent when the WORLD file is saved. SaveState() is plugin-state only. -- Persist after layout/gutter restoration so all suite-owned world presentation -- settings reach disk together. function PersistSuiteWorldSettings(announce) local worldPath = tostring(GetInfo(54) or "")
if worldPath == "" then if announce ~= false then InstallerNote( "yellow", "Consolas 11 is active, but this world has no saved .mcl path yet. " .. "Save the world once to make it permanent." ) end return false end
local ok, saveFailed = pcall(Save, "")
-- Lua's MUSHclient Save() return is inverted: false means success, -- true means the save failed. if not ok or saveFailed == true then if announce ~= false then InstallerNote( "red", "Could not save world settings to " .. worldPath .. (not ok and (": " .. tostring(saveFailed)) or ".") ) end return false end
if announce ~= false then InstallerNote( "lime", "Saved world settings (including Consolas 11) to " .. worldPath ) end
return true end
function UnloadBundledPlugins() -- Unload in reverse order so dependants disappear before their providers. -- A failure is isolated to that plugin: continue processing the rest of the -- suite and remember which existing copies must not be reloaded in-place. local failed = {} local failureCount = 0
for i = #SUITE, 1, -1 do local item = SUITE[i]
if IsPluginInstalled(item.id) then local rc = UnloadPlugin(item.id)
if rc ~= error_code.eOK then failed[item.id] = true failureCount = failureCount + 1 InstallerNote( "red", "Could not unload " .. item.name .. " (error " .. tostring(rc) .. "); leaving its existing copy alone and continuing." ) end end end
return failed, failureCount end
function LoadBundledPlugins(skipReload) local loaded = 0 local kept = 0 local failed = 0 skipReload = skipReload or {}
for _, item in ipairs(SUITE) do local path = JoinSuitePath(item.file)
if skipReload[item.id] and IsPluginInstalled(item.id) then kept = kept + 1 InstallerNote( "yellow", "Kept existing " .. item.name .. " because its previous copy could not be unloaded." ) elseif not FileExists(path) then failed = failed + 1 InstallerNote( "red", "Missing " .. item.name .. " file: " .. path .. " -- continuing with the remaining plugins." ) else local rc = LoadPlugin(path)
if rc ~= error_code.eOK then failed = failed + 1 InstallerNote( "red", "Could not load " .. item.name .. " (error " .. tostring(rc) .. "); continuing with the remaining plugins." ) else loaded = loaded + 1
if item.default_enabled == false then local enableRc = EnablePlugin(item.id, false) if enableRc ~= error_code.eOK then failed = failed + 1 InstallerNote( "red", "Loaded " .. item.name .. " but could not apply its disabled-by-default state (error " .. tostring(enableRc) .. ")." ) else InstallerNote( "gray", "Loaded " .. item.name .. " (installed disabled by production default)" ) end else InstallerNote("gray", "Loaded " .. item.name) end end end end
InstallerNote( failed > 0 and "yellow" or "lime", tostring(loaded) .. " bundled plugins loaded" .. (kept > 0 and (", " .. tostring(kept) .. " existing copy/copies kept") or "") .. (failed > 0 and (", " .. tostring(failed) .. " plugin error(s)") or "") .. "." )
return loaded, kept, failed end
function BundledLayoutPath() return JoinSuitePath(LAYOUT_FILENAME) end
function ApplyBundledLayout() ApplyWorldOutputFont(false)
local path = BundledLayoutPath()
if not FileExists(path) then InstallerNote( "yellow", "No " .. LAYOUT_FILENAME .. " found. Plugins are installed, but no shared window layout was applied." ) InstallerNote( "gray", "Put your saved " .. LAYOUT_FILENAME .. " beside the installer and use 'suite layout'." ) -- Even without a layout file, persist the suite font if possible. PersistSuiteWorldSettings(false) return false end
if not IsPluginInstalled(PLUGIN_CONTROLLER_ID) then InstallerNote("red", "Plugin Controller is not installed.") return false end
if PluginSupports(PLUGIN_CONTROLLER_ID, "LoadLayout") ~= error_code.eOK then InstallerNote("red", "Installed Plugin Controller does not support LoadLayout.") return false end
local rc, result = CallPlugin( PLUGIN_CONTROLLER_ID, "LoadLayout", "" )
if rc ~= error_code.eOK then InstallerNote( "red", "Plugin Controller could not load the layout (error " .. tostring(rc) .. ")." ) return false end
InstallerNote("lime", "Applied " .. LAYOUT_FILENAME .. ".")
-- This is intentionally a WORLD save, not SaveState(). It persists the -- output font plus world-level gutter/text-area settings applied above. PersistSuiteWorldSettings(true) return true end
function ScheduleBundledLayout() -- Loading plugins is synchronous, but giving their OnPluginInstall callbacks -- and first miniwindow redraws one second to settle makes the imported layout -- deterministic. This is a one-shot MUSHclient timer. DoAfterSpecial( 1.0, "ApplyBundledLayout()", sendto.script ) end
function SetPortableTriggerState(enabled) local value = enabled and "true" or "false" local ok = true
for _, id in ipairs({CORE_TRIGGERS_ID, CHAT_ROUTER_ID}) do if not IsPluginInstalled(id) then ok = false InstallerNote("red", "Portable trigger plugin is not installed: " .. id) elseif PluginSupports(id, "SetPortableEnabled") ~= error_code.eOK then ok = false InstallerNote("red", "Portable trigger plugin lacks SetPortableEnabled: " .. id) else local rc = CallPlugin(id, "SetPortableEnabled", value) if rc ~= error_code.eOK then ok = false InstallerNote("red", "Could not change portable trigger state for " .. id .. " (error " .. tostring(rc) .. ").") end end end
SetVariable("portable_triggers_enabled", enabled and "1" or "0") if enabled then SetVariable("portable_migration_pending", "0") end return ok end
function InstallSuite(applyLayout, disablePortableForMigration) InstallerNote("cyan", "Installing SquareSoft UI suite...") ApplyWorldOutputFont(true)
local savedPortableState = tostring(GetVariable("portable_triggers_enabled") or "")
local unloadFailures, unloadFailureCount = UnloadBundledPlugins()
local loadedCount, keptCount, loadFailureCount = LoadBundledPlugins(unloadFailures)
local pluginFailureCount = (tonumber(unloadFailureCount) or 0) + (tonumber(loadFailureCount) or 0)
if disablePortableForMigration then SetPortableTriggerState(false) SetVariable("portable_migration_pending", "1") InstallerNote("yellow", "Portable v2.0 trigger replacements were installed DISABLED to avoid double-firing with your existing world triggers.") InstallerNote("yellow", "Disable/delete the old world copies, then type: suite portable on") elseif savedPortableState == "0" then SetPortableTriggerState(false) elseif savedPortableState == "1" then SetPortableTriggerState(true) else -- Fresh install: the portable plugins default to enabled. Record that -- choice so later forced reinstalls preserve it deterministically. SetVariable("portable_triggers_enabled", "1") SetVariable("portable_migration_pending", "0") end
SetVariable("suite_installed_once", "1") SetVariable("suite_installed_version", INSTALLER_VERSION) SaveState()
if applyLayout ~= false then ScheduleBundledLayout()
InstallerNote( pluginFailureCount > 0 and "yellow" or "lime", pluginFailureCount > 0 and ( "Install completed with " .. tostring(pluginFailureCount) .. " isolated plugin error(s). Healthy plugins remain active; " .. "saved layout will still be applied in about one second." ) or "Install complete. Saved layout will be applied in about one second." ) else InstallerNote( pluginFailureCount > 0 and "yellow" or "lime", pluginFailureCount > 0 and ( "Bare install completed with " .. tostring(pluginFailureCount) .. " isolated plugin error(s). Layout was NOT applied." ) or "Bare install complete. Layout was NOT applied." ) InstallerNote( "gray", "Test the resize handles now; then use 'suite layout' separately." )
-- Bare installs still own the portable font. Save it after the current -- installer callback unwinds rather than requiring File -> Save manually. DoAfterSpecial( 0.25, "PersistSuiteWorldSettings(true)", sendto.script ) end
return pluginFailureCount == 0 end
function SuiteInstallAlias() InstallSuite(true, false) end
function SuiteInstallBareAlias() InstallSuite(false, false) end
function SuitePortableOnAlias() if SetPortableTriggerState(true) then InstallerNote("lime", "Portable trigger replacements ENABLED.") end end
function SuitePortableOffAlias() if SetPortableTriggerState(false) then InstallerNote("yellow", "Portable trigger replacements DISABLED.") end end
function SuitePortableStatusAlias() local pending = GetVariable("portable_migration_pending") == "1" local enabled = GetVariable("portable_triggers_enabled") ~= "0" InstallerNote(enabled and "lime" or "yellow", "Portable trigger replacements: " .. (enabled and "ON" or "OFF")) if pending then InstallerNote("yellow", "Migration pending: disable/delete the old world trigger copies, then use 'suite portable on'.") end end
function SuiteLayoutAlias() ApplyBundledLayout() end
function SuitePathAlias() InstallerNote("cyan", "Suite folder:") Note(SuiteDirectory()) InstallerNote("cyan", "Expected layout file:") Note(BundledLayoutPath()) end
function SuiteStatusAlias() InstallerNote("cyan", "Bundled plugin status:")
for _, item in ipairs(SUITE) do local status = IsPluginInstalled(item.id) and "installed" or "NOT installed"
Note(" " .. item.name .. " : " .. status) end
Note( " " .. LAYOUT_FILENAME .. " : " .. (FileExists(BundledLayoutPath()) and "present" or "NOT present") ) end
function DeferredInitialSuiteInstall() SetVariable("initial_install_pending", "0")
local installedVersion = tostring(GetVariable("suite_installed_version") or "")
if installedVersion == INSTALLER_VERSION then InstallerNote( "gray", "Suite v" .. INSTALLER_VERSION .. " is already current." ) return end
InstallerNote( "cyan", "Deferred bootstrap is now loading suite v" .. INSTALLER_VERSION .. "..." )
-- The one-time world-trigger migration is only needed when crossing from -- the old v1.x suite into v2+. Normal v2.x upgrades preserve the user's -- current portable-trigger state instead of switching it off again. local upgradingFromV1 = installedVersion ~= "" and not installedVersion:match("^2%.")
InstallSuite(true, upgradingFromV1) end
function QueueInitialSuiteInstall() if GetVariable("initial_install_pending") == "1" then return end
SetVariable("initial_install_pending", "1")
InstallerNote( "cyan", "Suite update queued until installer initialization has finished." )
DoAfterSpecial( 0.5, "DeferredInitialSuiteInstall()", sendto.script ) end
function OnPluginInstall() -- Reassert the package's world-output font whenever this installer is loaded. -- This keeps the portable profile deterministic even if the local world file -- was created with a different output font. ApplyWorldOutputFont(false) ScheduleWorldOutputFontReassert()
local installedVersion = tostring(GetVariable("suite_installed_version") or "")
if installedVersion ~= INSTALLER_VERSION then QueueInitialSuiteInstall() else SetVariable("initial_install_pending", "0")
InstallerNote( "gray", "Suite v" .. INSTALLER_VERSION .. " already installed. Use 'suite install' to force reinstall." ) end end
